seo.title: Majoolify | Software developer, frontend engineer, and AI prompt execution
seo.description: Agency-first portfolio for Majoolify, Ahmed Majoul's Tunisia-based software development studio focused on Next.js, frontend systems, and AI prompt workflows.

hero.title: Beautiful software products, sharp frontend systems, and AI workflows that actually ship.
hero.intro: Majoolify is the operating studio of Ahmed Majoul, a frontend-focused software developer and engineer from Tunisia. I build with Next.js, design for clarity, and shape AI prompt systems around real product constraints instead of demo energy.

credibility.title: Independent, registered, execution-first.
items: Majoolify is a legal individual software development agency structure operated by Ahmed Majoul from Tunisia.
The studio works across freelance delivery, product implementation, and agency-style execution for frontend-heavy software.
Projects can be public, partially redacted, or private by default depending on client sensitivity and launch timing.

services.title: Builds for teams that care about the product surface, not just the codebase.
services.intro: The emphasis is on fast execution with a clean visual point of view: editorial landing pages, operational dashboards, content systems, and AI-assisted flows that still feel intentionally designed.

work.title: Case studies with signals, not filler.
work.intro: A mix of public work, product experiments, and redacted delivery where the implementation is real but the client details stay private.

process.title: Shape, systemize, ship.
process.intro: The workflow is designed to reduce drift between vision, interface, and production reality.

steps.title: 1. Frame the product edge
steps.description: Clarify who the build is for, what it needs to prove, and which interface decisions actually move the outcome.

steps.title: 2. Build the system, not only the screen
steps.description: Translate the concept into route structure, reusable patterns, content model, and implementation constraints.

steps.title: 3. Refine until it feels authored
steps.description: Polish typography, pacing, motion, and hierarchy so the result feels deliberate rather than template-driven.

expertise.title: Frontend-heavy delivery with strong AI product instincts.
expertise.intro: The strongest fit is where product clarity, UI taste, and technical execution need to exist in the same person or studio.
points: Next.js App Router products with structured server-side and content workflows.
Case-study and landing-page systems that need to look premium without collapsing into generic SaaS polish.
Prompt architecture for admin surfaces, copilots, and internal workflows that need repeatability, not novelty.

story.title: Ahmed Majoul builds as an engineer, refines like a product owner.
body: I work mainly on frontend-heavy software with Next.js, but the real value is not limited to coding screens. I help shape how the product is presented, how the content is structured, and how the system keeps making sense as it grows.
Prompt engineering is part of that same discipline. The useful version is not just generating output; it is defining the interfaces, guardrails, and review loops that make AI features operational.
Majoolify exists as the agency layer around that work: a legal, client-facing vehicle for delivery, communication, and long-term software execution.

testimonials.title: The common feedback is clarity under pressure.
testimonials.intro: Speed matters, but only if the product still feels composed. That is usually where the strongest client signal comes from.

contact.title: Need a frontend partner or AI-minded builder who can execute directly?
contact.intro: Send the project brief, current constraints, and what needs to be true after launch. If the fit is right, I’ll propose the fastest practical path.
contact.formSuccess: Inquiry received. Ahmed will review it and get back to you.
